data.gender_notes: Elisha is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Elisha is recorded in name-lists as “My God is salvation”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Elisha expresses “My God is salvation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elisha total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
